title: Inconsistent underline thickness
explanation: The underline stroke thickness (underlineThickness in the post table) doesn't match what's expected for the family. Check that the value is consistent across all styles (regular, bold, italic…).

title: Incorrect PANOSE classification
explanation: The first PANOSE byte (bFamilyType) doesn't match the expected font type (Latin Text, etc.). This is a classification metadata used by some systems to pick a fallback font — fix it in the OS/2 info.

title: Missing dotted circle
explanation: The dotted circle glyph (U+25CC) is used to preview isolated diacritical marks; if it's missing, some tools can't correctly display marks out of context.

title: i/j dot not removed under accent (soft-dotted)
explanation: On characters like i, j (and their equivalents in other scripts), the dot should disappear when an accent is added above. Check the affected composite glyphs.

title: Kerning pairs
explanation: An issue was detected in the kerning pairs (missing, redundant, or conflicting with classes). Review the GPOS table / your kerning file.

title: fvar table (variable axes)
explanation: Issue with the variable axes or named instances definition. Check the min/max/default values and instance names in your variable source.

title: STAT table
explanation: The STAT table (which describes axes for applications) is missing, incomplete, or inconsistent with the instances in the fvar table.

title: Insufficient glyph coverage
explanation: Some characters expected for the targeted character set (e.g. Latin Core/Plus, Cyrillic…) are missing from the font.

title: Hinting
explanation: Issue related to hinting instructions (or their absence), affecting rendering at small sizes on some systems.

title: name table (naming metadata)
explanation: One of the fields in the name table (family name, subfamily, copyright, version…) is missing, malformed, or inconsistent between styles.
